authMapping.description:
A mapping of the {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Auth} field names to the corresponding litellm completion
dict keys. This is used to convert the auth configuration to the format expected by the litellm API
e.g. for {@link GenaiCore.Llm.AzureOpenAi} {@link https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/azure#completion---using-api_key-api_base-api_version}
`{"azureEndpoint": "api_base", "apiVersion": "api_version", "apiKey": "api_key"}`

title: Helper type to provide the details necessary for provider-specific completion via litellm.
name: GenaiCore.Llm.LiteLlm.ProviderMapping
